records.label: Portable arithmetic, comparison, concatenation, and percent operators
records.semantics: Parses and evaluates +, -, *, /, ^, &, comparisons, unary signs, and postfix percent with deterministic coercion and errors.
records.divergence: This is a declared portable subset, not every Excel, Sheets, or OpenFormula coercion edge.
records.importBehavior: Formula source is preserved and evaluated when every token is in the portable subset.
records.exportBehavior: Canonical formula source is emitted to XLSX without cached-value fabrication.

records.label: Bounded dynamic arrays and spill ranges
records.semantics: FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, TRANSPOSE, SEQUENCE, TAKE, DROP, CHOOSECOLS, CHOOSEROWS, direct range arrays, spill ownership, resizing, obstruction, history, and dependency invalidation are evaluated.
records.divergence: No implicit-intersection operator, spill-reference # syntax, multi-key SORT, higher-order LAMBDA array functions, or general Excel/Sheets dynamic-array family is claimed.
records.importBehavior: Recognized formulas evaluate; unknown dynamic-array syntax remains preserved source with an explicit formula error.
records.exportBehavior: Anchor formula source is exported; derived spill cells are not serialized as invented formulas.

records.label: Bounded lexical and lazy LET bindings
records.semantics: LET evaluates lexical, case-insensitive bindings lazily; inner bindings shadow outer bindings, and unused reads, errors, and volatility do not become dependencies.
records.divergence: At most 126 bindings and 16,384 expanded AST nodes are admitted; LET does not define or execute reusable functions.
records.importBehavior: Recognized LET source evaluates within the bounded lexical subset; invalid names, arity, or resource expansion return explicit formula errors.
records.exportBehavior: The exact formula source is preserved and emitted without a fabricated cached result.

records.label: LAMBDA and reusable named functions
records.semantics: Formula source is retained, but LAMBDA and higher-order execution are not evaluated.
records.divergence: LET is supported separately; no approximation, reusable named-function runtime, or JavaScript execution fallback is provided.
records.importBehavior: Source is preserved; evaluation returns an explicit unsupported-name error.
records.exportBehavior: Preserved source may be emitted, without a fabricated cached result.

records.label: Quoted cross-sheet references through stable worksheet identity
records.semantics: Cross-sheet references resolve by stable sheet handle and survive rename and reorder with canonical quoting.
records.divergence: External workbook links and 3-D references are unsupported.
records.importBehavior: Native same-workbook references map to stable worksheet IDs.
records.exportBehavior: References are rendered using the current canonical sheet name and quoting rules.

records.label: Create, rename, reorder, hide, unhide, remove, and active fallback
records.semantics: Stable IDs, canonical names, ordinary visibility, active fallback, history, rebase, persistence, and session export share one lifecycle.
records.divergence: veryHidden is host-managed and cannot be revealed through the stock tab strip.
records.importBehavior: Valid names and visibility are retained; invalid all-hidden workbooks fail or select a visible fallback as specified.
records.exportBehavior: Current Grid active state and ordinary visibility are emitted without mutating shared navigation history.

records.label: veryHidden worksheet preservation
records.semantics: veryHidden metadata remains formula-addressable and survives snapshot/XLSX round trips.
records.divergence: Stock worksheet tabs intentionally do not expose or unhide it.
records.importBehavior: The visibility token is retained as host-only state.
records.exportBehavior: The token is emitted when retained by the canonical workbook.

records.label: Independent XLSX strings, numbers, dates, and whitespace
records.semantics: A checksum-locked LibreOffice workbook imports the declared scalar and format subset without warnings.
records.divergence: Producer evidence covers this fixture and version, not all LibreOffice documents.
records.importBehavior: Expected normalized cells import with zero warnings.
records.exportBehavior: Equivalent Sheetwrite scalar cells export through the optional XLSX package.

records.label: Styles, merges, validation, notes, panes, names, and hidden sheets
records.semantics: A checksum-locked LibreOffice workbook imports the declared rich subset and exact warning boundary.
records.divergence: Hidden worksheet visibility produces the recorded unsupported-feature warning for the legacy fixture path.
records.importBehavior: Supported native parts normalize into the workbook; unsupported parts emit structured warnings.
records.exportBehavior: Canonical supported parts export; unknown OOXML parts are not promised lossless preservation.

records.label: ECMA-376 shared formula master and translated slaves
records.semantics: Shared formula records expand into canonical per-cell formula source with translated relative references.
records.divergence: Export writes canonical ordinary formulas rather than promising the producer's shared-record packing.
records.importBehavior: Master/slave records import as three exact formula sources.
records.exportBehavior: Equivalent formulas export semantically, not byte-for-byte or record-for-record.

records.label: Native data-validation subset
records.semantics: Declared comparison and list validations round-trip through the canonical validation model.
records.divergence: Unsupported operators or extension forms are dropped with exact structured warnings.
records.importBehavior: Supported rules normalize; unsupported rules do not masquerade as supported validation.
records.exportBehavior: Supported canonical rules emit native validation records.

records.label: Tables, charts, macros, pivots, slicers, and Power Query
records.semantics: Known unsupported OOXML parts are detected and reported rather than evaluated.
records.divergence: These application features are not imported into a parallel object model and are not claimed to round-trip losslessly.
records.importBehavior: Known parts emit exact unsupported-feature warnings; unsafe packages fail closed.
records.exportBehavior: Sheetwrite does not fabricate these parts.

records.label: CSV/TSV and browser clipboard interchange
records.semantics: Delimited export/import and HTML/plain clipboard paths preserve the declared scalar, formula, reference, and style subset with injection neutralization.
records.divergence: CSV/TSV cannot represent workbook structure, formulas with cached semantics, or rich OOXML features.
records.importBehavior: Bounded delimited text becomes typed columnar data; over-limit input fails explicitly.
records.exportBehavior: Leading formula-like text is neutralized and only the selected/active rectangular data is emitted.

records.label: Pinned Microsoft Excel-produced corpus
records.semantics: Five producer/version/checksum records are scheduled against the optional XLSX reader.
records.divergence: The workbook bytes are not redistributed; absent scheduled bytes remain unverified and cannot support a blanket Excel claim.
records.importBehavior: Checksum-matched supplied or scheduled bytes execute exact normalized expectations and warnings.
records.exportBehavior: No Excel resave claim is made without separately captured producer evidence.

records.label: Pinned public Google Sheets export
records.semantics: One non-redistributed public export has pinned URL, producer, checksum, expected subset, and warning boundary.
records.divergence: The local checkout contains metadata only; most Google Sheets workbook behaviors remain explicitly unverified.
records.importBehavior: Scheduled checksum-matched bytes may verify the declared export only; missing bytes display unverified status.
records.exportBehavior: No Google Sheets import or resave behavior is claimed.
